verdict.rationale: ROCm docs confirm framework support via inference recipes (vLLM, SGLang) and full-stack AI deployment guides, and independent benchmarking (chipsandcheese, HN) confirms real-world PyTorch/ROCm workloads run on MI355X hardware. However, there's no explicit official PyTorch support matrix, version compatibility table, or CI-tested framework list in the evidence, and community discussion focuses on performance/pricing rather than confirming broad framework compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch build/version support matrix, named mainstream frameworks beyond vLLM/SGLang (e.g., TensorFlow, JAX), and independent confirmation of ease of framework installation/compatibility.
